verdict.rationale: The smithery-cli GitHub repo documents a CLI with agent-oriented commands: searching the registry and adding MCP connections (`smithery mcp search/add`), finding and calling tools directly (`smithery tool find/call`), and pointing to the Skills Registry. That covers the core of an AI-native CLI workflow. Missing for 10: first-party Smithery docs confirming the CLI as official (the repo sits under an arcadeai-labs org), install/auth and usage documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration that it works.
